item.title: Render PDFs in Elixir with the Typst NIF
item.description: A Phoenix app renders its report PDFs inside the BEAM with the typst package's NIF. Why not headless Chrome or the Typst CLI, the checks a NIF has to pass, and a benchmark against the CLI.

item.title: A time on the Phoenix scope goes stale in a LiveView
Phoenix filter_parameters doesn't redact tokens in the URL path
Make the Phoenix scope the first argument
item.description: Pass Phoenix 1.8's Scope first to almost every public context function, and the context becomes one authorization layer for your LiveViews, controllers, APIs and MCP server.

item.title: Enforce Phoenix contexts with boundary
item.description: Phoenix contexts are a convention until something checks them. boundary makes a call from the web layer into a context's internals fail the build, even on an app that already breaks the rules.

item.title: MCP before REST when the caller is an agent
item.description: We wanted AI agents to work with our app. I built an MCP server with OAuth first, and REST only when a script that doesn't speak MCP needed the app too.

item.title: Mutation Testing Finds What Coverage Misses
item.description: Line coverage said our Phoenix app was 96% tested. Mutation testing with Muex, run only on a branch's changed lines and fast tests, found 17 changes no test caught.

item.title: Which id belongs in the URI
item.description: A record with its own primary key and an id from the upstream system that sent it. The upstream id usually belongs in the URI, when it passes three tests.

item.title: Re-fetch on a 409 when two Oban jobs create the same record
Where to block PromEx's /metrics
item.description: PromEx's plug serves /metrics on the Phoenix app's public port. Why blocking it at the load balancer beats an ingress-nginx snippet, and when a separate metrics port is simpler.
